Status:
- The EIA monthly generator table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx, Operating sheet, lists Plant 4072, generator 31, status OP, nameplate 91.0 MW, operating year 2003, technology Natural Gas Fired Combustion Turbine, entity Wisconsin Public Service Corp, latitude 44.54, longitude -88.0086. No planned retirement year is shown.
- A web search found no 2026 retirement, mothball or sale notice for this unit. I did not open the MISO retirement list or utility filings beyond that search.

Backup Power.note:
Backup power:
- The air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1214924 lists 'Stack S32, Process P32 - 83 MW simple cycle combustion turbine. Constructed in 2003.' as an electric power generation process. It does not call the unit an emergency or backup unit. The only emergency unit it names is a separate 25 kW natural gas generator, Process P91.
- This supports no backup power, but the permit does not say the word 'no'. So this is a weaker support.

units.notes: The unit still shows as operating in the September 2026 EIA table with no planned retirement. I did not look for the turbine maker or an operator, since the brief did not ask for them.
